models.old.title: {name} is now {doing}.
models.old.body: {from} isn’t used any more. Keep it to switch back without downloading, or remove it to free {size}.
models.old.removed: Removed {from} and freed {size}. You can get it again from this list at any time.
models.pick.intro.answering: It also reads your photos. Everything Nocturne can use is listed. Ones this computer can’t run are greyed, with the reason.
models.pick.intro.recordings: It turns voice notes and recordings into words. A change applies to new recordings; what you kept stays as it was read.
models.pick.intro.aloud: It reads your morning page and answers aloud. It runs on its own, so it never competes with the other jobs for memory.
models.pick.intro.finding: It matches each question to what you kept. Changing it means Nocturne re-reads everything you kept; the old way keeps working until that finishes.
models.pick.loading: Checking what this computer can run…
models.pick.error: Nocturne couldn’t check what this computer can run. Nothing has changed.
models.fit.fitsHint: runs comfortably beside the other jobs
models.fit.wontFitHint: needs more than this computer has to spare
models.pick.metaAlone: {size} · up to {memory} of memory, on its own

models.reason.memory: Too much memory beside the other jobs.
models.reason.otherJob: Fits only if {job} uses a smaller one.
models.reason.tight: Works, but Nocturne may slow down at its busiest.
models.why.memory: It needs up to {need} of memory while it works. Next to the other jobs, Nocturne would need more than the {budget} it allows itself, so everything else you run stays quick.
models.why.disk: Nocturne keeps some space spare so this computer never fills up. Getting this would use more than that: it needs {short} more free space.
models.why.unavailable: Nocturne has no way to run this on this computer, whatever the memory or space.
models.why.otherJob: With {job} as it is, this would need more than the {budget} Nocturne allows itself. It would fit if {job} used a smaller one.
models.online.name: Online answers
models.online.meta: Answers written by an online service you choose. Uses no memory here. Photos are still read on this computer, by {name}.
models.online.m9: Online answers need setting up first: which service, what is sent, and a monthly limit. Nothing is sent until you agree.
models.aloud.only: {name} is the only voice Nocturne can use for now. Choose its voice and speed in Settings, under Voice.
models.pick.note: The current one keeps working while anything new downloads.
models.confirm.quality: It’s smaller than {from}, so results may be less careful and miss details.
models.confirm.photos: Photos are read by it too.
models.confirm.download: Nocturne downloads it in the background. {from} keeps working until it’s ready, then Nocturne switches by itself.
models.confirm.present: It’s already on this computer, so nothing is downloaded.
models.confirm.reread: Nocturne will re-read all {items} things you kept so it can find them the new way. Until it finishes, it finds them the old way, so nothing goes missing. You can cancel and keep the old way.
models.confirm.listed: The download is listed on the Privacy page, like every download you agree to.
